  <!-- Joint frame: hinge axis along +Y (vertical edge), located at left vertical edge of cabinet face -->
  <!-- Cabinet spans X: [-0.185, +0.185], Y: [-0.22, +0.22] with origin at center on floor -->
  <!-- Hinged on vertical edge at X = -0.185. Door swings outward (toward -Y). -->
  <joint name="door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="door"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.185 0.220 0.845" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 1 0"/>
    <limit lower="-1.57079632679" upper="0.0" effort="50" velocity="2.0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Make the joint/hinge door frame consistent with door geometry -->
  <!-- Door link geometry is defined relative to joint frame such that:
       - door thickness extends in Y (local Y) from 0 to +0.01/2 in the door local box origin at y=0.22,
       - door spans height in Z from 0..1.69 with local box centered at z=0.845 -> joint at z=0.845,
       - door spans width across X; box centered at x=0 relative to joint frame where hinge is at x=-0.185 of cabinet.
  -->
</robot>
